notes: Added missing core logic and external API integration stories for FEAT-3.

FEAT-3-S95.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Recruiting Trials Search Logic
FEAT-3-S95.description: Implement core domain logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting status filter, parse results, and normalize trial metadata including title, condition, phase, and locations.

FEAT-3-S96.title: Travel Distance and Duration Calculation
FEAT-3-S96.description: Integrate Google Routes API within clinical_trials_service to compute distance and travel time from user location to each trial site, including batching and error handling for missing coordinates.

FEAT-3-S97.title: Clinical Trial Location Extraction and Formatting
FEAT-3-S97.description: Extract trial site locations from API response, normalize address fields, and prepare structured output for downstream sorting and display including city, state, and coordinates.
